source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of osmoregulation with the Recalling box (PDF 4).

blocks.text: Jism ki rutoobaton (body fluids, jaise khoon aur tissue fluid) mein pani aur ghule hue maddon (solutes, jaise namak) ka tawazun qaim rakhna osmoregulation kehlata hai. Is se jism ki rutoobatein na bohat patli (dilute) hoti hain na bohat gaarhi (concentrated). Yeh jism ke bohat se kaamon ke liye zaroori hai, maslan blood pressure ko theek rakhna, organs ka theek kaam karna aur metabolism (jism ke kimiyai amal) ko qaboo mein rakhna.

blocks.title: Yaad karein (Recalling)
blocks.text:
• Osmosis jhilli (membrane) ke paar pani ki diffusion hai. Pani hamesha zyada patle (hypotonic) mahlool (solution) se kam patle yaani zyada gaarhe (hypertonic) mahlool ki taraf jata hai.
• Kisi mahlool ka osmotic pressure is baat ka paimana hai ke woh osmosis se kitna pani apni taraf khenchta hai.

blocks.prompt: Osmosis se pani kis taraf jata hai?
blocks.explanation: Zyada patle (hypotonic) mahlool se zyada gaarhe (hypertonic) mahlool ki taraf.

items: Osmoregulation = jism ki rutoobaton mein pani aur namak ka tawazun.
Is se blood pressure, organs ka kaam aur metabolism theek rehte hain.
Osmosis mein pani patle (hypotonic) se gaarhe (hypertonic) mahlool ki taraf jata hai.
